To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• the termination and confluence of a term rewriting system are not preserved under most combinations of systems; • the termination of a term rewriting is not preserved under the parallel combination of two systems; • the confluence of a conditional term rewriting system is preserved under the parallel composition of two systems; and • the confluence and the termination of a conditional term rewrite system are preserved under the sequential composition of two systems.

(i) The preservation of confluence and termination under various types and combinations of rewriting is not always possible, but in many situations it is possible to ensure the preservation of these properties by imposing certain syntactic and/or semantic conditions on the systems involved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
termination and confluence of term rewrite systems, and their structural aspects.
termination and confluence of conditional term rewriting systems and their structural aspects.
termination and confluence of unconditional and conditional (term) rewriting systems.
